def test_user_registration_and_auth():
    username = generate_random_string()
    password = generate_random_string()
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("username") == username

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_address_and_card_management():
    username = generate_random_string()

    addr_payload = {
        "city": "Test City",
        "country": "Test Country",
        "number": "123",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "street": "Test St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert addr_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_data = resp.json()
    assert addr_data.get("city") == "Test City"

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_data = resp.json()
    assert card_data.get("expires") == "12/25"
    assert "3456" in card_data.get("longNum")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_operations():
    customer_id = generate_random_string()
    item_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    item_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 10.5}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["itemId"] == item_id

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_end_to_end_order_workflow():
    username = generate_random_string()

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)

    addr_payload = {
        "city": "Test City",
        "country": "Test Country",
        "number": "123",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "street": "Test St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    socks = resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    sock = socks[0]

    item_payload = {"itemId": sock["id"], "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": sock["price"]}
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None
    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in orders)

def test_payment_authorization():
    order_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {
            "city": "Test City",
            "country": "Test Country",
            "number": "123",
            "postcode": "12345",
            "street": "Test St"
        },
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {
            "ccv": "123",
            "expires": "12/25",
            "longNum": "1234567890123456"
        },
        "customer": {
            "firstName": "Test",
            "lastName": "User"
        },
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth["orderId"] == order_id
    assert auth["authorised"] is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 2
